'''January 2001 Geneva tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Beyond Reality, Geneva, Illinois on 6 January 2001. [[Jonathan Grubb]] won it. It is known from Alex Helmke's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1608">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-09-geneva-illinois-01-06-00d1608/ geneva-illinois-01-06-00], DeckTech (Alex "aljex" Helmke, 9 January 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-09-geneva-illinois-01-06-00d1608/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 6 January 2001
* '''Site:''' Beyond Reality, Geneva, Illinois
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Jabba's Palace Sealed Deck]]
* '''Players:''' 23
* '''Winner:''' [[Jonathan Grubb]]
